title: Store status counts
objective: Count stores by status with COUNTIF, using a criteria cell, a text criterion and a not-equal criterion.
instructions: The store list is in A1:C11. In F2:F4, use COUNTIF on the Status column (C2:C11) to count the stores with the status named in E2:E4. Fix the range with $ signs and point the criteria at the cell in column E. In F5, count the stores that are not Open, using "<>Open". In F6, count the stores whose Region (B2:B11) is Kisumu by typing the text "Kisumu" in the formula.
hints: COUNTIF has two parts: =COUNTIF(where to look, what to count).
For F2, look in the Status column $C$2:$C$11 and count the status in E2. Copy the same pattern for F3 and F4.
For F5 use the criteria "<>Open" in double quotes. For F6 look in the Region column $B$2:$B$11 and use "Kisumu". Some list entries use lower case; COUNTIF ignores case.
